readout_other: fiber photometry of GCaMP6s calcium signal in striatal cholinergic neurons
direction_notes: All five animals showed increased cholinergic GCaMP6s fluorescence in the 3 s after ultrasound compared with sham (control pulses at zero amplifier gain).
safety_notes: Temperature rise in striatum measured ex vivo with a fiber optic hydrophone did not exceed 0.1 C; the mechanical index is stated as 0.19.

device.model: custom single-crystal lithium niobate transducer (128YX cut), 5 x 5 mm, 500 um thick

timing.protocol_description: Pulse timing, PRF, duty cycle and stimulus duration are not stated. Ultrasound ON trials were interspersed with control pulses run at zero amplifier gain; the response was quantified in the 3-s window after stimulus delivery.

source_quotes.n_subjects: All animals (N = 5) showed significant increases in cholinergic calcium activity upon ultrasound stimulation compared to controls (Figures 4C, D).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: We also analyzed the vibrational characteristics of this device using laser Doppler vibrometry and found that the fundamental thickness mode’s resonance frequency was 6.56 MHz (Figure 1L).
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: This device can deliver stimuli with 0.3–0.5 MPa peak negative pressure in a deep brain region, the dorsal striatum.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: Single-crystal lithium niobate transducers operating in the fundamental thickness mode with lateral dimensions of 5 x 5 mm and a thickness of 500 μm were used in this study.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: Single-crystal lithium niobate transducers operating in the fundamental thickness mode with lateral dimensions of 5 x 5 mm and a thickness of 500 μm were used in this study.

flags.reason: 0.3-0.5 MPa peak negative pressure was measured through the intact skull in an ex vivo head preparation (fiber optic hydrophone in striatum) at varying input powers; not clear which level was used in the photometry trials.
Paper gives no pulse timing at all.
Paper argues 6.56 MHz is outside the mouse hearing range; no control experiment, so recorded as 'other'.
N = 5 for photometry; other numbers (6, 5-6) refer to rotarod and open-field tests without ultrasound output.
Fiber photometry does not fit a listed readout; recorded as other.
Transducer fabricated in-house (authors' own lithium niobate element).
